tagline.en: Tencent's embodied vision-language-action policy for robot control, driven by images and instructions.
tagline.zh: 腾讯的具身视觉-语言-动作策略,以图像与指令驱动机器人控制。

en: HY-Embodied is Tencent's vision-language-action (VLA) model for embodied robot control. It takes camera images together with a language instruction and produces robot actions — a policy that maps what the robot sees and is told to do into what it does.

WorldFoundry runs HY-Embodied through an official image-text runtime adapter, so it slots into the shared inference flow. The published checkpoint is hosted on Hugging Face and is pulled in at run time.
In WorldFoundry you give the model observations and an instruction, and it returns an action policy rollout for the robot.
zh: HY-Embodied 是腾讯的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,用于具身机器人控制。它接收相机图像与一条语言指令,输出机器人动作——是一个把「机器人看到什么、被要求做什么」映射到「机器人怎么做」的策略。
WorldFoundry 通过官方的图文运行时适配器运行 HY-Embodied,使其融入统一的推理流程。已发布的 checkpoint 托管于 Hugging Face,在运行时载入。
在 WorldFoundry 中,你把观测与指令交给模型,它便返回机器人的动作策略推演。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you need an embodied VLA policy that turns camera views and a natural-language instruction into robot actions.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个具身 VLA 策略、把相机视角与自然语言指令转化为机器人动作时,选它。

notFor.en: It is a control policy, not a media generator — it outputs robot actions, not video or images. The checkpoint downloads separately, so stage it before running.
notFor.zh: 它是控制策略而非媒体生成器——输出的是机器人动作,而非视频或图像。Checkpoint 需单独下载,请在运行前先备好。

en: Consumes camera images plus a language instruction
Runs through an official image-text runtime adapter
zh: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作策略
输入为相机图像加语言指令
通过官方图文运行时适配器运行
Checkpoint 已发布于 Hugging Face
